title: Richard Moon — A Life in the Art of Harmony
author: Richard Moon
exact_source_text: Richard Moon is an Aikido instructor, mediator, author, musician, and lifelong student of the human condition, based in the San Francisco Bay Area. A sixth dan of Aikikai Honbu Dojo, his life's work has unfolded across three seemingly distinct yet deeply connected fields: martial arts and somatic practice, conflict resolution and diplomacy, and executive leadership and coaching. Moon began his martial arts journey in 1969 and encountered Aikido in 1971 under Robert Nadeau, a direct student of Morihei Ueshiba. He attended a seminar with physicist David Bohm exploring the practice of Dialogue and studied nonviolent communication with Marshall Rosenberg. Conflict isn't something to win or lose. It's energy waiting to be transformed. O Sensei called Aikido "the realization of love."
